full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain, J. Delay of 07 days in filing this civil petition for leave to appeal is hereby condoned. This civil petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 02.10.2012 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 3870 of 2008 disposing of the Rule with modification and affirming the judgment and decree dated 10.08.2008 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, First Court, Chittagong in S.C.C. Suit No. 06 of 2005 decreeing the suit. 

 5. The trial Court upon hearing the parties by the judgment and order dated 10.08.2008 decreed the suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree of the trial Court, defendant No. 10 preferred a revisional application before the High Court Division and obtained Rule in Civil Revision No. 3870 of 2008. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division upon hearing the parties by the judgment and order dated 02.10.2012 disposed of the Rule with modification and directed the defendant-petitioner to vacate the suit shop and to pay arrear rent with Tk. 25/- per day as compensation within 2(two) months.
